reference_project: God's Eye View (GEV) Open Surveillance Architecture
relationship_to_gev: adsb.lol serves as the primary community ADS-B/Mode-S aggregation backend and open telemetry reference architecture for the God's Eye View project.

geographic_coverage_query.target_airspace: Mumbai FIR (VABB / BOM) and coastal airspace

acquisition_method: Automated HTTP GET request to REST v2 geographic bounding circle endpoint with 25s timeout

verified_licence.data_licence: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) v1.0

attribution_requirements.required_credit: Must attribute source as 'adsb.lol and its contributors' and include notice of the ODbL license in any public distribution or Produced Work
attribution_requirements.share_alike_clause: ODbL v1.0 Section 4.4 requires public derivative databases to be distributed under ODbL v1.0
attribution_requirements.open_access_clause: ODbL v1.0 Section 4.6 prohibits DRM or technical measures that restrict access

provenance.origin: Airborne aircraft transponders (1090 MHz Mode-S / ADS-B Extended Squitter)
provenance.ingestion_layer: Volunteer SDR ground station receivers uploading via dump1090/readsb feeds
provenance.aggregation_layer: adsb.lol globally distributed ingestion and deduplication servers

source_limitations: Feeder Density Variation: Coverage is proportional to volunteer SDR receiver density; reduced fidelity over open ocean and unpopulated landmasses.
Temporal Snapshot: Per-request snapshot; requires continuous scheduled polling or WebSocket streaming for uninterrupted tracking.
MLAT Dilution of Precision: Multilaterated targets exhibit higher horizontal variance compared to GNSS-backed ADS-B.
Barometric Datum: Uncorrected pressure altitudes assume standard atmosphere (1013.25 hPa) rather than local QNH.
Uncooperative Targets: Aircraft with disabled or non-functioning transponders cannot be tracked.

governance_notice.notes: Source metadata prepared for formal BHIV MasterDB evaluation. No write or registration has been executed.
